test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, concat('toxx', toString(number % 500000), ' the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog') FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE message LIKE '%toxx12345%'
